entries.source: Activate the infusion to heal for %d%% of all damage taken (calculated before resistances) and reduce the duration of a random debuff by %d each turn for %d turns.
entries.old_target: 激活这个纹身，你受到的伤害将部分转化为治疗（在抗性减免之前计算），转化比例为 %d%%。 此外，每回合减少一个随机负面效果的持续时间 %d 回合，持续 %d 回合。
entries.new_target: 激活这个纹身，使你在受到伤害后若仍存活，恢复相当于该次伤害（抗性减免前计算）%d%% 的生命值，并每回合减少一个随机负面效果的持续时间 %d 回合。上述两项效果均持续 %d 回合。

calculation_arguments_consumer.calculation: inscriptions.lua:189,195 computes power=data.power+data.inc_stat*10 and reduce=floor(data.reduce+data.inc_stat*2); info order is power, reduce, data.dur. The info getter uses (data.reduce or 0).
calculation_arguments_consumer.arguments: inscriptions.lua:189 passes the same power/reduce to a single EFF_PRIMAL_ATTUNEMENT for data.dur.
calculation_arguments_consumer.consumer: physical.lua:913-919 installs/removes damage_affinity.all=eff.power; 919-925 reduces one random detrimental effect duration by eff.reduce on timeout. Both belong to the same timed effect. damage_types.lua:325-329 stores affinity_heal=max(0,dam*combatGetAffinity(type)/100) before resistances at 352 onward; takeHit resolves damage at 553; 608-609 separately heals only when not target.dead and affinity_heal>0.
calculation_arguments_consumer.conclusion: Affinity is separate healing after resolved damage, only for surviving target; basis is before resistance reduction, not before every kind of damage reduction; affinity and debuff shortening share data.dur.

entries.source:
Turn your attention to a nearby foe, and dominate them with your overwhelming presence. If the target fails to save versus your Mindpower, it will be unable to move for %d turns and vulnerable to attacks. They will lose %d Armour, %d Defense and your attacks will gain %d%% resistance penetration. If the target is adjacent to you, your domination will include a melee attack.
		Effects will improve with your Willpower.

		This talent will also attack with your shield, if you have one equipped.
entries.old_target:
将注意力转向附近的敌人，以压倒性的气势将其压制。如果目标未能通过对抗你精神强度的豁免鉴定，它将在 %d 回合内无法移动，并更易受到攻击。目标的护甲降低 %d， 闪避降低 %d， 且你的攻击对其获得 %d%% 抗性穿透。如果目标与你相邻，压制时还会发动一次近战攻击。
		效果受意志加成。

		如果装备了盾牌，本技能还会用盾牌发动攻击。
entries.new_target:
将注意力转向附近的敌人，以压倒性的气势将其压制。如果目标未能通过对抗你精神强度的豁免鉴定，它将在 %d 回合内无法移动，并更易受到攻击。目标的护甲降低 %d， 闪避实际降低相同数值（闪避提示值为 %d）， 且你的攻击对其获得 %d%% 抗性穿透。如果目标与你相邻，压制时还会发动一次近战攻击。
		效果受意志加成。

		如果装备了盾牌，本技能还会用盾牌发动攻击。

calculation_arguments_consumer.calculation: strife.lua:42-47 calculates armorChange=-combatTalentStatDamage(wil,4,30) and defenseChange=-combatTalentStatDamage(wil,6,45), which may differ.
calculation_arguments_consumer.arguments: strife.lua:60 passes both into EFF_DOMINATED. info at 86 retains tformat(duration,-armorChange,-defenseChange,resistPenetration), so third placeholder is the defense display value.
calculation_arguments_consumer.consumer: mental.lua:713 sets combat_armor from eff.armorChange; 714 also sets combat_def from eff.armorChange, not eff.defenseChange. Both temporary values are removed at 720-721. mental.lua:704 still displays -eff.defenseChange.
calculation_arguments_consumer.conclusion: Actual armor and defense reductions are equal. Third numerical interpolation remains unchanged and is explicitly described as a display hint rather than actual reduction; no source/args_order alteration.
